comment: Two source gates, two egress paths, as draft-decide-run. `repeat`: a runner MUST evaluate these activations against input.lg this many times and check that every run's per-gate verdicts, master decisions and log trace are identical to `expected`/`log` below, then evaluate the same activations once against each file named in `permutations` (relative to this vector's directory) and check the same thing again. A determinism vector has no expected.json; `expected` and `log` here are the dynamic result both input.lg and every permutation MUST reproduce, every time.
